concerns.text: FR-001 is defined twice – once in the main Functional Requirements section and again in the placeholder Spec Template. Duplicate FR IDs violate the uniqueness rule and create ambiguity about which definition applies.
FR-002 is defined twice – once in the main Functional Requirements and again in the placeholder Spec Template, causing ID conflict.
FR-003 is defined twice – once in the main Functional Requirements and again in the placeholder Spec Template, leading to duplicate identifiers.
SC-001 appears both in the Success Criteria section and again in the placeholder Spec Template, creating duplicate success‑criterion IDs.
SC-002 is duplicated in the same way as SC-001.
SC-003 is duplicated, violating unique identifier policy.
Attribute name typo: "prosocia_keyword_count" (missing the 'l') is used in the Key Entities table, while the rest of the document consistently uses "prosocial_keyword_count".

The generic Spec Template section (User Scenarios & Testing, Requirements, etc.) is left in the document with placeholder IDs that clash with the real specification, causing a silent scope shift and confusing the reader.
Task T015b references a non‑existent requirement FR‑002c; only FR‑001, FR‑002, FR‑003 exist. This cross‑reference cannot be resolved.
